beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Residents need reasons for decisions, alternative providers, and ways to challenge plans.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: A repairable machine helps only when the parts, knowledge, and authority are accessible.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Begin with the Planetary Mirror Test, then examine the Constitution of Constructive Capacity.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Read it to ask what a beautiful place must let its inhabitants control.
